title: Joint Optimization for Federated Learning and Transmission over Unreliable Wireless Networks with Heterogeneous Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.14246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In wireless federated learning (FL), data heterogeneity and multiple local updates induce client drift, degrading model convergence. It is further affected by unreliable wireless links, as transmission errors may invalidate model updates. To address these challenges, we propose a federated random walk averaging (FedRW) framework, which is a variant of federated averaging (FedAvg) that mitigates data heterogeneity by updating models along random walk (RW) paths and aggregating them at the server. Model parameters are transmitted in packets with retransmission support to improve training quality by mitigating wireless errors along RW paths. Meanwhile, wireless transmission delays hinder the exploration of FedRW. To this end, we formulate a joint optimization problem that integrates learning, RW path selection, and transmission parameter tuning, aiming to minimize the training loss under delay constraints. translated_title: 面向异构数据的不可靠无线网络中联邦学习与传输的联合优化
translated_abstract: 在无线联邦学习（FL）中，数据异构性和多次本地更新会导致客户端漂移，降低模型收敛性能。而不可靠的无线链路会进一步加剧这一问题，因为传输错误可能使模型更新失效。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种联邦随机游走平均框架，这是联邦平均（FedAvg）的一种变体，通过沿随机游走（RW）路径更新模型并在服务器端进行聚合，从而缓解数据异构性问题。模型参数以支持重传的数据包形式传输，通过减轻RW路径上的无线传输错误来提高训练质量。与此同时，无线传输延迟也阻碍了对FedRW的深入探索。为此，我们构建了一个联合优化问题，将学习过程、RW路径选择和传输参数调整整合在一起，目标是在延迟约束下最小化训练损失。通过推导……的上界（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出联邦随机游走平均框架，通过联合优化学习过程、随机游走路径选择和传输参数，在不可靠无线网络中缓解数据异构性和传输错误对模型收敛的影响。
en_tdlr: Proposes a federated random walk averaging (FedRW) framework that jointly optimizes learning, RW path selection, and transmission parameters to mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity and transmission errors on model convergence over unreliable wireless networks.
